notes: Open/exposed states are treated as on and closed states as off. The two double-door upper cabinets are represented as separate leaf events because each leaf is a distinct movable part; their transitions occur within the same short sampled intervals, so individual-leaf timing is less certain.
scene_description: A user moves around a modern kitchen and sequentially opens and closes the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, then manipulates lids on two countertop cookers and the basket drawer of an air fryer.
